<entry id="A01601">

<sense>
<definition> (= h. יְקָר, v. 
<xref rid="A00007">אִי־</xref>) 
<italic>honor, glory</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Targ. Prov. XI, 16; a. fr.—Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>d</sup> איקרִי וכ' my honor counts for nothing before the honor of my Maker. Ib. II, 4
<sup>b</sup> מה את פליג ליה א' (not אתפליג) what honor dost thou pay it (by passing by)?; Y. Shek. II, 47
<sup>a</sup> top.—Y. Peah VIII, 21
<sup>b</sup> bot. פרנסה דא' an honorable livelihood. Y. Ḥag. I, 76
<sup>d</sup> top איגרא דא', v. אִיגְּרָא.—
<plural-form>Pl. אִיקְרִין</plural-form>
<italic>presents, greetings</italic>. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>d</sup> (some ed. איקלין).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A01602">

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (אור, cmp. חור) 
<italic>white substance, undyed wool</italic> or 
<italic>cotton</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 11
<sup>b</sup>; (Tosef. ib. I, 8 missing). Ib. 79
<sup>a</sup> דוגמא לא' a sample color for the wool (given to the dyer).—
<plural-form>Pl. אִירִין</plural-form>. B. Kam. 119
<sup>b</sup>, the remnants of wool in the hands of the dyer. [R. Hanan. reads אִידָּא q. v.] [Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 4 אִירָה; Kel. XXI, 1 עִירָה.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>there is, are; est qui</italic> &c. Targ. Gen. XVIII, 24; a. fr.—Y. Ber. VI, end, 10
<sup>d</sup> א' תניי תני וכ' one Tannai reads … R. Hash. 11
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. כדאיתא as it is, i.e. as stated.</definition>
<notes>—אית לי 
<italic>I have, I hold</italic> (the opinion).—Snh. 90
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מר כדאית ליה וכ' the one in accordance with the opinion he holds, and the other &c.—B. Mets. 5
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. אם איתא לדר' … if the opinion of R. … has (had) any substance, i.e. if we must adopt his authority.—Yoma 41
<sup>a</sup> מאי א' לך למימר what hast thou to reply?—B. Mets. 3
<sup>a</sup> מאי א' לי גבי וכ' what have I to do with the hired man?—Yeb. 116
<sup>a</sup> כי אִיתְנֵכוּ בש' when ye are in Shili &c.—Compounds אית־כא, contr. אִיכָּא; לא איתא contr. לֵיתָא. [אִיתָאִי, אִיתִי, 
<italic>my existence, I am</italic> = h. עֹודִי. Targ. Ps. CIV, 33; a. e.] Cmp. אִיתַי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
